ledger: 00:00–00:01.25: A, initially the left green numbered block, is pinched by the single visible hand, lifted and rocked; it becomes blue and expands into a blue 2 on the table plus a separately held blue 3 (B).
00:01.25–00:09.75: A remains the leftmost blue 2 on the tabletop; the hand contacts and slightly aligns it with B at 00:09–00:09.75.

00:01–00:02: B emerges beside A under the same fingers, is carried slightly right and placed between A and the original right green block. B remains the second, blue 3 through 00:09.75, with hand contact during final alignment.

00:00–00:03.25: C, the original right green 2, rests on the table until grasped around 00:02.25. The hand lifts and rocks it, showing 3; by 00:03.25 a green 2 remains in the third position while a separate green 3 (D) is held beside it.
00:03.25–00:09.75: C remains the third green 2 on the table; fingers briefly contact its top around 00:08.50.

00:03.25–00:04: D is held immediately right of C, initially green with 3, then yellow with 2 by 00:03.75. It is placed fourth while another blue block (E) emerges at its right. D remains the fourth yellow 2 through 00:09.75, with brief hand contact around 00:08.25–00:08.50.
00:04–00:05: E emerges under the fingers beside D as a pale blue 3, is placed fifth by 00:04.75, and remains there while another blue 3 (F) emerges at its right. E stays fifth through 00:09.75.

00:05–00:06: F is held to the right of E, initially blue with 3, then green with 3. Around 00:06, its exposed front becomes 5 as a separate green/blue 3 (G) emerges to its right. F remains the sixth green 5 through 00:09.75.

00:06–00:06.75: G is rocked in the same hand immediately right of F, displaying 3. By 00:06.75 a green 2 occupies the seventh tabletop position while a separate blue 3 (H) remains held farther right. G stays seventh through 00:09.75.

00:06.75–00:08: H is held and rocked at the far right, displaying 3 until approximately 00:07.75, when its exposed front becomes 6. It is released as the eighth blue 6 by 00:08 and remains there through 00:09.75.
00:00–00:09.75: No container or hand-to-hand transfer is shown. The small circular top studs remain associated with their blocks; none is separately handled. Audio is unassessed.

findings.entity: Initial left block A and emerging blue block B
findings.description: Around 00:00.75–00:01.25, the single held block becomes blue and its visible right side widens into a second full block with its own top stud. A blue 2 is left on the table while the same pinch carries a blue 3 away. The visible body changes from one block into two beneath the fingers, rather than a separately concealed block simply being uncovered.

findings.entity: Original right green block C and emerging block D
findings.description: At 00:02.75 the fingers hold one green block displaying 3. Around 00:03–00:03.25, that block separates visually into a stationary green 2 and a held green 3 immediately beside it, increasing the visible count from three to four. The second body grows from the exposed side of the handled block without a distinct incoming object.

findings.entity: Fourth block D and emerging pale blue block E
findings.description: The green 3 held at 00:03.50 becomes a yellow 2 by 00:03.75. As that yellow block is set down around 00:04, an additional blue body extends from its right side beneath the fingers and becomes a separate pale blue 3 by 00:04.50. The placement leaves one block behind while producing another from the same visible body.

findings.entity: Fifth pale blue block E and emerging block F
findings.description: After the pale blue 3 is placed fifth at 00:04.75, another blue 3 extends from its right side around 00:05 and is held separately by 00:05.25, while the placed block remains. The newly held block then changes from blue to green around 00:05.50–00:05.75 while its exposed 3 face stays directed toward the camera. The visible surface changes cannot be explained solely by a concealed pickup.

findings.entity: Sixth green block F and emerging block G
findings.description: Immediately before 00:06, the held green block has an exposed front marked 3. That front changes to 5 as a second green/blue block marked 3 extends from its right side. The green 5 stays on the table while the fingers carry the new 3 rightward. The frontal numeral and body change in view without a covering hand or a turn exposing a different face.

findings.entity: Seventh block G and emerging blue block H
findings.description: Between 00:06.50 and 00:06.75, the single greenish block marked 3 beneath the fingers becomes a green 2 resting in the seventh position plus a separately held blue 3 at its right. The held body visibly produces an additional block while leaving the first behind, with no separate source or transfer.

Around 00:07.70–00:07.80, the rightmost held block changes its exposed front numeral from 3 to 6. The same front face remains visible during a small rocking motion; it is neither covered nor rotated away to reveal another numbered face. The hand then releases the altered block in the eighth position.
